newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch, Russians sign defence cooperation agreement.
newsitem.headline: Dutch, Russians sign defence cooperation agreement.

text.p: The Netherlands and Russia will sign a memorandum of understanding on defence cooperation on Wednesday, the Dutch Defence Ministry said.

Under the agreement the Netherlands has offered to help destroy large stores of chemical weapons in Russia's Kambarka region, and to step up food production at the military farms which feed Russia's defence forces, the ministry said.
Russian Defence Minister Igor Sergeyev has already signed the document and Dutch Defence Minister Joris Voorhoeve is due to sign it in the presence of a Russian military delegation.
A 20-strong Russian delegation arrived in the Netherlands on Sunday for a week-long working visit.
